scope: Single-owner audio decode, two-step cold smoke only
observations: All eight workers received shutdown in the same logged second and logged cleanup completion four to five seconds later.
Two workers exited without a signal; six reached the 15-second grace limit and received terminate. No kill was needed.
The first-request E2E was slower than the prior cleanup-only smoke (154.52 s). This is not evidence of a latency gain; warmed repeated A/B is required before accepting this candidate.
verification_limits: Only two-step matched media parity was validated. No 50-step speedup, general quality result or clean lifecycle is claimed. Raw logs/media remain private.
